result.title: When Guidance Becomes a Guard: Early Interception of Unsafe Inputs in Text-to-Image Generation
result.summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can produce unsafe content, while output filtering intervenes only after synthesis. We investigate whether native generation signals enable early detection of unsafe and adversarial inputs. We find that classifier-free guidance exposes strong safety signals in conditional responses, accessible through compact statistics and linear readouts. Based on this finding, we propose Conditional Semantic Trajectory Interception (CSTI), which aggregates activation contrasts between conditional and unconditional responses at early checkpoints for calibrated risk detection. CSTI fits concept-specific detectors using canonical concept and safe examples, without attack samples, intermediate image decoding, or generator modification. Across five generators, four adversarial attack collections, and two general NSFW datasets, CSTI achieves the strongest overall performance among six baselines at a matched 5% FPR. Early interception reduces generation latency by over 60% on intercepted paths. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of native conditional responses for early safety interception.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究文本到图像扩散模型能否在生成早期从原生信号中发现不安全或对抗输入，发现 classifier-free guidance 的条件与无条件响应对比中蕴含较强安全信号，并提出 CSTI：在早期 checkpoint 聚合条件/无条件激活差异，用少量正例与安全样本拟合线性读出实现校准风险检测，无需攻击样本或改动生成器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「条件与无条件激活对比＋线性读出＋跨 checkpoint 聚合」的可供核查线索，或可用于诊断 VLM 内部状态是否真正使用视觉证据（视觉旁路、信息坍缩），早期拦截的时机选择也可能类比 LVR 的停止决策，但属推测。
